races.paceDynamic: Frankies Fortune and Kayla's Friend will contest the early lead, with both horses committed to front-running tactics creating an honest gallop throughout. Lowlands and Hunters Spring will track prominently behind the leaders, while the majority field (Bracing Brook, Quinnfinity, Expensive Emotion, Kaydence, Nufinbutdatruth, Oor Wish) will be held up off the pace. The dual pace scenario should create a solid tempo but not overly demanding fractions given this is a maiden hurdle field. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace who can position close enough to strike, as the hold-up horses face a significant disadvantage having to make up substantial ground against fresher legs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders set reasonable fractions without burning each other out completely
scenarios.body: Lowlands or Hunters Spring can utilize their prominent positions to strike when the leaders weaken, benefiting from perfect tactical positioning. Their styles allow them to stay close enough without doing the donkey work early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets first run on their rival and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: Frankies Fortune appears the stronger of the two leaders and could dictate terms if allowed to control the tempo. Her recent form edge over Kayla's Friend suggests she can outlast her pace rival.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Powers Home
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly aggressive and the leaders come back dramatically
scenarios.body: Kaydence with Sean Bowen could time her challenge perfectly from off the pace, using superior class to reel in tired leaders. Her hold-up style only works if significant pace collapse occurs up front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Chaos Ensues
scenarios.trigger: If jumping errors or interference disrupts the anticipated pace dynamic significantly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where any horse avoiding trouble can capitalize regardless of running style. Form and ratings become secondary to race positioning and jumping fluency.

races.paceDynamic: Newtown Rambler and Hypotenus will go forward early and establish a strong gallop over this sharp 2m trip at Perth. Both have the pace to set up an honest tempo, with Dance Thief and Mister Cessna likely to track them prominently. The sustained early pace will stretch the field and create opportunities for those who can travel well behind the speed. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers who can position close to the pace without getting embroiled in the early speed battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Strong Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If both Newtown Rambler and Hypotenus go hard from the start and maintain a strong tempo throughout
scenarios.body: The honest pace will suit those positioned prominently who can pick up the pieces when the leaders tire. Dance Thief and Mister Cessna are perfectly placed to capitalize on this scenario.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: The strong early gallop sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong. Garde Des Champs and Next Twist have the class to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If one leader drops out early leaving a more sedate pace for the remainder
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical with a sprint finish, favoring horses with tactical speed who can position well. Mister Cessna and Hypotenus can adapt to these conditions best.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wire-to-Wire Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Newtown Rambler or Hypotenus gets an uncontested lead and dictates throughout
scenarios.body: One of the leaders maintains control and kicks clear when challenged, holding on for victory. The front-runner benefits from not having to engage in early pace pressure.

races.paceDynamic: Manowest is the only confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable pace from the start without pressure. Ebselysees and Shoeshine Boy may track close as prominent runners, but neither is aggressive enough to challenge for the early lead. With such a limited pace angle, the race will develop into a staying test where patient hold-up horses get ideal conditions to unleash late runs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can deliver sustained finishes over the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Manowest sets uncontested fractions and the field remains bunched turning in
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade gets perfect tactical conditions as the pace lifts late, allowing multiple closers to deliver telling challenges. Class horses with finishing kicks thrive when the race becomes a pure staying test.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If Ebselysees or Shoeshine Boy apply more early pressure than expected
scenarios.body: The increased pace tempo stretches the field earlier, bringing prominent runners into contention as some hold-up horses fail to get competitive positions. Those tracking the pace inherit better winning positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Manowest Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the front runner's sustainable gallop proves too strong for the closers
scenarios.body: His uncontested lead builds into an unassailable advantage as the hold-up horses' challenges come too late on the testing ground. Patient tactics backfire when the leader maintains his rhythm.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Manowest stops suddenly or makes jumping errors under pressure
scenarios.body: The race develops into a sprint finish between whoever is left with a chance, creating chaos where any running style can prevail. Form lines become irrelevant in a scrambled finish.

This controlled pace strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid a cavalry charge, as the hold-up brigade will face a wall of horses when making their moves.

scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Potters Party sets a steady tempo and the prominent horses can position perfectly behind
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Foxinthebox and Deerstalker to travel sweetly before pouncing when the pace quickens approaching the final obstacles. Their tactical positioning proves decisive over the hold-up horses who have too much ground to make up.

The hold-up quartet of Mistral Milly, Popa Rich, Getaway Master, Mayor Of Maghera and Velvet Vulcan will need clear passages late but may benefit from the moderate pace. This race shape strongly favours front-running and hold-up horses who can avoid the prominent traffic jam.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dublinofficecallin Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If the leader gets soft fractions and isn't pressured until late
scenarios.body: Dublinofficecallin can dictate throughout and prove hard to peg back, while any hold-up horse finding a clear run benefits from the solid pace. The prominent group gets locked in traffic and can't mount effective challenges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos

scenarios.body: The pace becomes messy mid-race as Byron Hill, Gonnino, Prince Nino and Takeyoutotheisland interfere with each other's progress. This allows Dublinofficecallin to steal a march while hold-up horses sweep up late.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If Byron Hill can secure a dream passage through the prominent congestion and kick clear
scenarios.body: His superior official rating and consistent form tells, breaking away from the traffic to chase down Dublinofficecallin. The Patrick Neville runner's tactical speed proves decisive in a race where positioning matters most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If both the leader tires and prominent runners get stopped in their tracks
scenarios.body: Getaway Master or Mayor Of Maghera produce telling late kicks from clean runs while the pace collapses ahead of them. The Micky Hammond runner's recent Hexham second suggests he retains ability despite modest recent form.
